title: Pokémon Champions launches April 2026 on Switch with paid starter pack for 'early progression support'
content: The Pokémon Company has announced Pokémon Champions, a free-to-play competitive battler, will launch in April 2026 on Nintendo Switch and Switch 2. The game launches with a paid upgrade pack described as providing 'useful in-game items' to 'support early progression,' a monetization approach that has drawn scrutiny from players concerned about pay-to-win mechanics in a competitive game.
